knowledge_items_revision_pointer_check.name: knowledge_items_revision_pointer_check
knowledge_items_revision_pointer_check.value: ("knowledge_items"."current_revision_no" = 0 AND "knowledge_items"."current_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("knowledge_items"."current_revision_no" > 0 AND "knowledge_items"."current_revision_id" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_items_active_pointer_check.name: knowledge_items_active_pointer_check
knowledge_items_active_pointer_check.value: ("knowledge_items"."status" = 'active' AND "knowledge_items"."active_revision_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("knowledge_items"."status" <> 'active' AND "knowledge_items"."active_revision_id" IS NULL)
